---
title: "Curriculum Vitae"
author: "John Paul Broussard"
format:
  pdf:
    template: awesome-cv.tex
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    keep-tex: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{enumitem}
        \setlist[itemize]{
            topsep=0pt,
            partopsep=0pt,
            itemsep=0pt,
            parsep=0pt,
            leftmargin=2ex,
            before=\vspace{-1mm},
            after=\vspace{0.5mm}
        }
        \setlength{\parskip}{0.5mm}
        \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
date: now
date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Load required libraries
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Source data and helper functions
source(here("jpbsCVdata", "load_cv_data.r"))
cv_data <- load_cv_data(here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx"))

# LaTeX helper functions
source(here("jpbsQuartoCV_pdfFiles", "latex_helpers.R"))

# Set PDF flag
is_pdf <- TRUE
is_html <- FALSE
```
